summary: Correct and current, but the top 10 is mostly new Chinese and Asian supertalls nobody knows, while every famous building a player names (Empire State, Taipei 101, Willis, Chrysler, Shard) costs a life.
reasons: Casual found 3 (Burj Khalifa, One WTC, Shanghai Tower) and lost all 5 lives on Empire State (#60), Taipei 101 (#11), Chrysler, The Shard and Willis Tower (#26). Sears Tower was not recognized at all.
Top 10 matches the current CTBUH ranking, but Merdeka 118, Ping An, both CTF Finance Centres and CITIC Tower are names only enthusiasts know, so the curve is a few gimmes then a wall.
Thin Blitz: 10 of 18 casual names scored; Chrysler, Shard, Trump Tower and John Hancock carry no height.
fixes: Add 'Sears Tower' as an alias of #26 Willis Tower (its name until 2009 and what most people call it).
'burj al arab' is fuzzy-corrected to Burj Almasa: add Burj Al Arab to the pool or stop that correction.
Drop the alias 'Central Park' on Central Park Tower (it is the park) and the truncated alias 'Trump International Hotel and'.
Add 'Petronas Towers' and 'Petronas Twin Towers' as a shared alias of Petronas Tower 1 and 2 so the natural guess offers the choice.
Jeddah Tower is unfinished but costs a life as an accepted answer; make unbuilt towers free or say 'completed buildings' in the prompt.
